description: This file contains the implementation of the LayoutManager class, responsible for managing form layouts, widget instantiation, and rendering in the SuiteCRM project. It defines methods for setting attributes, resolving widget classes, and rendering widgets and their queries.

classes.name: LayoutManager
classes.description: Manages layout, widget rendering, and class instantiation for form components within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes layout settings and database manager for the layout.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a specific attribute key-value pair in the defs array.

methods.name: setAttributePtr
methods.description: Sets a reference to a value for a specific attribute key.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific attribute key.

methods.name: getClassFromWidgetDef
methods.description: Resolves and instantiates the widget class based on widget definition, default settings, and mappings.

methods.name: getFieldDef
methods.description: Retrieves the field definition for a widget based on the module and name, utilizing cache.

methods.name: widgetDisplay
methods.description: Renders the widget for display, returning the display name or widget HTML.

methods.name: widgetQuery
methods.description: Returns the query string for a widget, used in filtering.

methods.name: widgetDisplayInput
methods.description: Renders the input widget for editing.
